teenKit.tldr: Lab tests can lie to doctors when antidotes create chemical illusions that look like massive overdoses. Medicine relies on 'One Medicine,' proving that human, dog, and cat biology share the exact same underlying rules and vulnerabilities.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding that numbers on a screen do not always reflect reality teaches us to question data, think critically, and look at the whole system instead of blindly trusting a single metric.
keyTakeaways: Treating the patient instead of the lab report is critical because antidotes like DigiFab can create phantom chemical illusions of high toxicity.
The 'One Medicine' concept proves that mammalian bodies—from humans in the ICU to dogs and cats in veterinary hospitals—share deeply connected physiological machinery.
Complex metrics like half-lives, enzyme epitopes, and blood shunts reveal how hidden molecular gears dictate life-or-death medical decisions.
